segments: After his parents passed away, their safe deposit box in Ohio was turned over to the state.
Then a local TV news team started asking questions.
And a box arrived in the mail.
Hundreds of savings bonds. Cash. Coins. Collectibles.
It happens more than you think. When someone passes away, old accounts, forgotten policies and safe deposit boxes get lost… and the money goes to the state.
If you've lost a parent, a grandparent, or a spouse… search their name too.
Tap below and take the 60-second check.
